feature: Social group metadata moderation, tag persistence, and privacy confirmation
root_causes: The FE group create form submitted name, description, and tags without a moderation approval check.
The backend Group model did not store tags, and Explore mapping omitted tags.
Backend group creation and changed metadata updates had no moderation boundary.
The FE privacy update omitted the confirmationPassword required by the backend request contract.
Create and settings dropdown menus rendered below their modal overlay, which intercepted option clicks.

pre_fix_failure_first.observed: The create flow expected one moderation request but received zero; the group dropdown option click was intercepted by the dialog overlay.
Flagged group creation reached persistence without moderation, and a rejected metadata update did not throw.
The old privacy payload contained only privacyType and omitted the required confirmationPassword.

implementation: FE creation requires explicit moderation approval for group name, description, and tags before submission.
FE settings moderates changed group metadata and skips moderation for privacy-only changes.
Monolith independently moderates create and changed metadata updates before persistence and fails closed on provider failures or non-approved results.
Group tags persist on the entity and are returned from Explore mapping.
Privacy changes collect and validate the current password and include confirmationPassword in the request.
Group modal dropdown menus render above their dialog overlays.

focused_result.cases: Create moderation refusal/retry, tag and privacy payload, metadata update refusal, and privacy password validation/submission.

full_e2e.expected_skips: Two live graph cases because localhost:8080 was unavailable; four mutually exclusive flag-off cases.

frontend.production_build: PASS with Graph Explorer, Graph Evidence, and research flags enabled

limitations: Browser API calls use local fixtures; no live FE-to-Monolith group transaction was exercised.
Backend tests use Mockito; Mongo persistence and the production moderation provider were not exercised.
The full E2E suite skips the live graph cases while the Monolith is unavailable and skips mutually exclusive flag-off cases.
